issue.title: Record the decision that whole-item = overrides the running Pomodoro and == is retired

task_type_fields.proposed_change: Proposed by bob-cli-9j.1 note 1, 9j.2 note 1, 9j.3 note 1, 9j.4 note 1, and 9j.5 note 1. Add the immutable decision strand `eq-overrides-the-running-pomodoro`. **Applies to:** bob-cli and Bob Mac Capture. **Claim:** a whole-item `=` / `=<X>` restarts the running Pomodoro and `=[<X>]#name` swaps another one in (an empty `<X>` keeps the running clock, so `=#bugs` hands it over; `=5#bugs` starts fresh). `==` is retired with a teaching error that names its one-`=` rewrite. Link and task starts (`^route:id=`, `@route:id=<X>`) never override. Bob Mac Capture commits an override only after its orange banner was on screen: every real submit passes the hidden `--refuse-override` unless the on-screen preview for this exact draft, generation, and bob client showed the override. **Why:** `==` duplicated `=` in every state except the still-running refusal, and the warning plus the commit-time guard replace that refusal. **Rejected:** keeping `==` as an alias; keeping the refusal; a confirmation every time; guessing intent on overdue sessions (the overdue banner teaches `x =` instead). **Cost:** a CLI `=` overrides with no preview beyond the yellow warning line. **Reopens when:** an unintended override happens with the banner on screen. **Evidence:** plan:202610/eq_overrides_running_pomodoro.md; bob-cli 5ec1390e, b9788c45, ec9009fd; bob-mac-capture 4c391eb, 12219ef. Link [[decisions:mac-capture-is-a-thin-client]]. The epic's decision_record=no was an automatic default with no human review, and no memory was changed during landing. Run `sase memory init` only when implementing with appropriate authorization.

issue.creation_reason: All five bob-cli-9j phases proposed this decisions strand after the auto-selected decision_record=no skipped it; keep it as a separate, reviewable memory change.
